answer: Anchor each identity to three proofs. First, the agent shows a work history older than 60 days that peers can inspect. Second, it locks $25 in a payment channel for 30 days. Third, its device key emits a signal every hour, woven into a trellis of peer checks where neighbours verify each other. A fake starts at its nadir: zero history, zero stake, zero verified signal. Faking 10,000 identities needs 10,000 sixty-day histories, $250,000 locked, and 10,000 hourly signals running nonstop. Like a trellis that bears weight only once its vines grow thick, trust is grown, never printed.
